title: cacalia mexicana
intro: Cacalia mexicana, commonly known as Mexican plume flower, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia mexicana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. By modulating the body's response to stress, this plant may also have a positive impact on the immune system and overall well-being.
